guesses.reason: Short, dense coat in a classic blue-gray and white bicolor pattern with a white blaze, chest, and paws, typical of random-bred domestic cats.
The solid blue-gray portions of the coat and green eyes hint at blue-coated ancestry, though the white spotting rules out a purebred.

breed.appearance: A slender, medium-sized shorthaired cat with a solid blue-gray coat over the head, ears, shoulders, and back, broken by bright white on the muzzle, chin, chest, belly, legs, and paws, with an inverted-V white blaze running up between the eyes to the forehead. Large upright gray ears with pinkish inner edges, round yellow-green eyes, and a dusky gray-pink nose with a small gray smudge beside it on the white muzzle. Long white whiskers and a few small dark spots on the white toe pads finish the look.
breed.fun_fact: Gray-and-white bicolor cats like Buddy wear a one-of-a-kind 'tuxedo in blue' pattern, so no two have exactly the same markings!
